set.body:
Purpose

Create one canonical support topology serving spatial frames, residual pair statistics, and local metric recipes.

Representation

Store ordered node supports and a union co-occurrence pair graph. Do not store dense p-wide legs, an m-by-p-squared frame, or a persistent per-support k-squared lookup table. Report actual support sizes and co-occurrence degree; do not assume the union graph has the same degree as one searchlight.

Acceptance

- Regular-volume construction uses an offset stencil or domain-native neighborhood provider, not all-pairs R distance loops.
- Small fixtures agree exactly with brute-force supports and co-occurrence pairs.
- The index exposes deterministic identities, block iteration, local gather, and structural memory estimates.
- A 50-60k-feature fixture builds without quadratic-in-p allocation.
- Cost preflight reports sum nnz(K_x), sum k_x squared for dense metrics, and projected sum k_x cubed factorization work.
- If the projected dense-local path is infeasible, that result narrows scope before implementation rather than being hidden.
set.title: Epic 1: Build the shared support and pair-pattern spatial index
